summary: Senior QA Engineer with 5 years of experience in quality assurance and test automation for international SaaS products and a telecom platform. API automation in Java (REST Assured, JUnit 5) and Karate, E2E testing with Playwright and Cypress, tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines, and test strategy in fully remote, distributed Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban). ISTQB CTFL v4.0 certified.

jobs.meta: Remote. Telecom OSS platform for EWE (Germany)
bullets: QA on the OSS transformation of EWE, a German telecom and energy provider, built on TM Forum ODA standards.
Design and run the tests for service-order flows in Jira and Xray: add, modify, delete, suspend and reactivate.
Building API test automation with Karate against TM Forum APIs, and built a one-click Postman smoke suite that checks every service after a production deployment.

jobs.meta: Remote. International SaaS, cybersecurity and threat modeling
bullets: Led the testing strategy for the Security Content module, one of the product's core components, defining the test mix across the testing pyramid (backend, API and frontend).
Designed and maintained Playwright and TypeScript E2E automation for the rules engine, covering combinations of conditions and actions, with Page Objects, API-backed setup and data factories.

Designed and deployed a Python optimization model (MILP) to split E2E tests across CI containers: 42% faster in a one-worker run. Modelling the 5 production workers showed 4 containers instead of 7 would be about 8% faster and 41% cheaper.

Backend API automation in Java with REST Assured and JUnit 5 (Given-When-Then, JSON schema validation, negative cases, Qase traceability), plus API testing with Postman across development, staging and production.
Took part in the migration from TestCafe to Playwright with TypeScript: about 80% less execution time and a more stable suite.
Contributed to CI/CD pipelines in Bitbucket and applied Shift Left, reviewing requirements and technical designs early and turning them into test cases.

Designed and executed functional, regression and integration tests across multiple client projects, reporting 500+ bugs prioritised by product risk and business criticality, with data validation through SQL queries.
Built and maintained automated E2E suites with Cypress and JavaScript, moving the team's testing from manual to a scalable automation model.
Produced the team's technical QA documentation (test plans, test cases, reports) and managed defects in Jira, coordinating releases with development.
Onboarded and mentored new team members on tools and automation best practices, reducing ramp-up time.
